captions.detailed: This is a realistic, highly detailed articulated task lamp featuring a heavy circular base with a dark grey and light grey concentric design. An intricate, dual-strut linked arm structure rises from a swivel bracket, constructed with multiple mechanical linkages, cross-bars, and joints. The lamp head is a cylindrical spotlight with a black casing, rear cooling fins, and a translucent yellowish lens. The joints allow the arm to pivot forward and backward, and the head to tilt independently.
captions.instruction: Generate a highly detailed articulated task lamp using CadQuery. The model should feature a heavy circular base, an intricate dual-strut linked arm with realistic mechanical joints, and a cylindrical lamp head with cooling fins and a translucent lens, utilizing dark grey and black materials.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a wide, flat cylinder layered with a smaller concentric cylinder. Build the arm's swivel bracket using box and cylinder primitives, then construct the lower and upper linked arm assemblies by repeating thin rectangular struts, cross-bars, and cylindrical joint pins. Model the lamp head by combining a main cylinder with smaller boxes for cooling fins, a hollowed front recess, and a thin circular disk representing the lens. Define revolute joints at the base-to-arm, mid-arm, and arm-to-head connections to enable realistic articulation.
